object.attr: derived: written with the security fix, from the requirement and the code view's finding.
object.description: Make a document's folder, then each of its objects, links, figures, views and filters folders, a link (a junction on Windows) to a folder elsewhere; separately make an object file, the manifest and a figure symbolic links to files elsewhere; make a folder directly under the repository root a link to another project's document; and compare the working copy of a document whose links folder, or one object file, is a link. Expected: each document with a linked folder or file is a load error that names the entry, and nothing behind it is read; the linked folder at the root isn't listed as a document and its objects show nowhere; change detection doesn't walk into a link; Compare refuses the linked folder and doesn't show the linked file's content; a document without links loads as before.
